items.title: GitHub release: anthropics/claude-code v2.1.267
items.what_happened: ## What's changed - Added `maxEffortLevel` setting (top-level or per model under `modelSettings`): caps the effort level on every provider, including Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry; users can still pick a lower level - Added `--system-prompt-snapshot off` to render the system prompt fresh on every request instead of reusing the conversation's recorded prompt (for iterating on prompt text) - Fixed Cowork scheduled tasks
